techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: DNS
techniques.description: Adversaries use the DNS protocol for command and control, blending malicious traffic with normal DNS resolution — frequently abusing TXT records to carry commands and beaconing on a regular cadence.

techniques.name: Protocol Tunneling
techniques.description: Adversaries tunnel another protocol's data inside DNS queries/responses to bypass network controls, producing many high-entropy subdomains fanning out under a single tunnel domain.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Unencrypted Non-C2 Protocol
techniques.description: Data is exfiltrated over an unencrypted protocol such as DNS, encoding large payloads into long data labels and sustaining a high query rate to push bytes out.
